title: On Fetching the doctor from the next town
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：fetch　|　正文 357 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 fetch 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the gardener ① fetched the doctor from the next town in the rain, and every apprentice in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three springs on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the gardener ② fetches the doctor from the next town without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ fetch the doctor from the next town at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ fetched the doctor from the next town before — a line in the notebook for April 1964 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Fetching the doctor from the next town in the rain, the gardener said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the trowel at the far bed, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ fetch a good price at the fair without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Fetch a good price at the fair at once and never mention it again.

By 1977 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the notebook, and a new apprentice from the next garden ⑧ fetches a good price at the fair in the rain every spring without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bed, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ fetched the doctor from the next town again when nobody else would.

⑩ To fetch the doctor from the next town, my mother said in 1982, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the garden remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the garden forgets, somebody fetches the doctor from the next town without complaint again and somebody must fetch the doctor from the next town in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 取来（一般过去式 fetched the doctor from the next town：1970 年园丁头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 取来（一般现在 fetches the doctor from the next town：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 取来（不定式 to fetch the doctor from the next town：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 取来（过去完成时 had fetched the doctor from the next town：1964 年四月的园艺笔记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 取来（动名词 fetching the doctor from the next town 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 卖得（fetch a good price at the fair：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去卖得在集市上卖得好价钱）
G. v. 卖得（fetch a good price at the fair：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 取来（后段两处：新来的学徒照例 fetches a good price at the fair，而母亲又一次 fetched the doctor from the next town）

answers.why: fetch 意为“取来”，1970 年园丁淋着雨取来去邻镇把医生请来，那是园子里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 fetched。
fetch 意为“取来”，自那以后园丁毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 fetches。
fetch 意为“取来”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯取来去邻镇把医生请来”，此处为不定式 to fetch the doctor from the next town。
fetch 意为“取来”，园艺笔记里 四月 那行字说明早在 1977 年之前就有人取来过，故用过去完成时 had fetched。
fetch 意为“取来”，园丁说“取来去邻镇把医生请来这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 fetching the doctor from the next town 作主语。
fetch 意为“卖得”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去卖得在集市上卖得好价钱”，should ever 之后用原形 fetch a good price at the fair。
fetch 意为“卖得”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻卖得在集市上卖得好价钱（fetch a good price at the fair at once），以后再也不要提起。
fetch 意为“取来”，新来的学徒每个春天都照例卖得在集市上卖得好价钱，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 fetches。
fetch 意为“取来”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨取来去邻镇把医生请来，用一般过去式 fetched 叙述。
fetch 意为“取来”，结尾那句是母亲 1982 年的话：要取来去邻镇把医生请来，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和园子记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 fetch 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1970 the gardener fetched the doctor from the next town in the rain, and nobody in the garden forgot it.
Even now the gardener fetches the doctor from the next town without complaint whenever the garden asks.
Fetching the doctor from the next town in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever fetch a good price at the fair without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new apprentice from the next garden fetches a good price at the fair in the rain every spring, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother fetched the doctor from the next town again, and the garden remembered that half.
